summary: A literal route registered after a same-shape parameter route on the same router and method is dead (Starlette matches in order). Opt-in per router variable name via router_names; suppress with a reasoned # route-order-ok marker.
changelog: - New gate `route_literal_after_catchall` (hard, no advisory mode, opt-in): a `@router.<method>("/a/{x}")` declared before `@router.<method>("/a/literal")` on the same router object is reported; `{x:path}` converters are not compared segment-wise. Requires `router_names=` (empty is a usage error). Suppress with `# route-order-ok: <reason>`.
owner_actions: Add a [[gate]] entry for route_literal_after_catchall to src/py_ci_shared/registry.toml and a README catalogue row (owner-owned files; not edited here).

Consumers that run FastAPI or Starlette routers (autopsia, noema, glossum api) must pass their router variable names; the measured corpora are the pyutilz and mlframe src trees, which hold no router calls matching the named list.
